**Nike had the higher gross margin in fiscal 2024.** Its margin was about 26.7 percentage points above Tesla's. These figures come from my recollection of the 10-K filings, not from a search.

- **Nike (fiscal year ended May 31, 2024):**
  - Revenue was about $51,362M and cost of sales about $28,475M, so gross profit was about $22,887M.
  - That gives a gross margin of about 44.6%.
- **Tesla (fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2024):**
  - Revenue was about $97,690M and gross profit about $17,450M.
  - That gives a gross margin of about 17.9%.

The difference is 44.56% − 17.86% ≈ 26.7 percentage points.
